sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每天晚上都要带着300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，并把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个类似充满美感的50年历史文物的动态快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, President Trump stuns lawmakers with his calls for gun control and his disregard for the NRA.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统呼吁加强枪支管控并对美国全国步枪协会（NRA）表现出蔑视，这让议员们大为震惊。

sentences.en: They have great power over you people, he said.
sentences.zh: 他对你们这些人有很大的影响力，他说。

sentences.en: They have less power over me.
sentences.zh: 他们对我影响力较小。

sentences.en: And Hope Hicks says she's leaving the Trump administration one day after testifying that her job requires telling white lies for the president.
sentences.zh: 霍普·希克斯表示，在她作证称自己的工作需要为总统说善意的谎言一天后，她将离开特朗普政府。

sentences.en: March 1St.
sentences.zh: 3月1日。

sentences.en: So good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: This is a very important subject, and it's happening, I think, at a critical time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的主题，而且我认为它发生在一个关键时刻。

sentences.en: Mike, there's this meeting at the White House on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 迈克，周三白宫有这样一场会议。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么回事？

sentences.en: Well, it was really remarkable.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的很引人注目。

sentences.en: This was a discussion that the president hosted in the Roosevelt Room at the White House with a bunch of Democratic and Republican lawmakers from the House and Senate.
sentences.zh: 这是总统在白宫罗斯福厅主持的一场讨论，与会者包括来自众议院和参议院的一群民主党和共和党议员。

sentences.en: Mike Scheer watched the meeting at the White House on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 迈克·希尔观看了周三在白宫举行的会议。

sentences.en: The ostensible reason was to kind of discuss possible solutions, possible responses to the tragedy that happened down in Florida a couple weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 表面上的原因是为了讨论针对几周前在佛罗里达州发生的悲剧的可能解决方案和可能回应。

sentences.en: We now have to do something.
sentences.zh: 我们现在必须做点什么。

sentences.en: We have to act.
sentences.zh: 我们必须行动起来。

sentences.en: We can't wait and play games.
sentences.zh: 我们不能等待，不能玩政治游戏。

sentences.en: Directly on his left is Senator Dianne Feinstein of California, one of the leading proponents of gun control measures.
sentences.zh: 紧挨着他左手边的是来自加利福尼亚州的参议员黛安·范斯坦，她是枪支管控措施的主要倡导者之一。

sentences.en: On his right is Senator John Cornyn of Texas, a Republican leader in the Senate, and, you know, a real sort of hardcore gun rights kind of senator.
sentences.zh: 在他右手边的是来自德克萨斯州的参议员约翰·科宁，他是参议院的共和党领袖，你知道的，算是一种非常坚定的枪支权利派参议员。

sentences.en: And then, you know, around the table, other members.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，围绕着桌子还有其他成员。

sentences.en: We're determined to turn our grief into action.
sentences.zh: 我们决心将悲伤化为行动。

sentences.en: I really believe that.
sentences.zh: 我真的坚信这一点。

sentences.en: I think that the people at this table want it.
sentences.zh: 我认为这张桌子旁的人们都希望如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I see some folks that don't say nice things about me, and that's okay, because if you turn that into this energy,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我看到有些家伙不说我的好话，没关系，因为如果你把这转化为这种能量，

sentences.en: I'll love you.
sentences.zh: 我会爱你的。

sentences.en: So how does this meeting start?
sentences.zh: 那么这场会议是如何开始的呢？

sentences.en: Well, it starts, I think, as many meetings with Trump starts, which is sort of a soliloquy by the president.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为它的开始方式和特朗普的许多会议一样，也就是总统的一段独白。

sentences.en: And he launches into a discussion about how we have to get something done.
sentences.zh: 他开始讨论我们如何必须把事情做好。

sentences.en: We can't just talk and talk and talk and talk.
sentences.zh: 我们不能只是说个不停。

sentences.en: And then he sort of ticks through his issues, the mental health.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始逐一过问他关注的问题，心理健康。

sentences.en: We have to confront mental health.
sentences.zh: 我们必须正视心理健康问题。

sentences.en: There's never been a case that I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是我从未见过的情况。

sentences.en: I'm sure everybody would feel the same.
sentences.zh: 我确信每个人都会有同感。

sentences.en: Where mental health was so obviously, 39 different red flags.
sentences.zh: 心理健康问题是如此明显，有39个不同的危险信号。

sentences.en: I mean, everybody was seeing him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有人都看到了他。

sentences.en: He talks about the idea of improving the defense of schools.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了加强学校防御的想法。

sentences.en: You've got to have defense, too.
sentences.zh: 你也必须有防御措施。

sentences.en: You can't just be sitting ducks.
sentences.zh: 你不能只是任人宰割。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what we've allowed people in these buildings and schools to be.
sentences.zh: 而这正是我们允许这些建筑和学校里的人们所遭遇的。

sentences.en: You know, as you sort of settle in to watch it at the very beginning, you don't necessarily expect it to kind of veer the direction that it did.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当你一开始坐下来观看时，你未必会料到它会朝着那个方向转变。

sentences.en: I'm the biggest fan of the Second Amendment.
sentences.zh: 我是宪法第二修正案的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: Many of you are.
sentences.zh: 你们中的很多人也是。

sentences.en: And then he says, but.
sentences.zh: 接着他说，但是。

sentences.en: I'm a big fan of the NRA, but I had lunch with them, with Wayne and Chris and David.
sentences.zh: 我是NRA的超级粉丝，但我跟他们吃过午餐，和韦恩、克里斯以及大卫一起。

sentences.en: And he goes on to describe the lunch that he had over the weekend with the leadership of the NRA, with Wayne LaPierre, the highly controversial and well-known CEO of the NRA,
sentences.zh: 接着他描述了周末与NRA领导层共进午餐的情况，包括NRA备受争议且广为人知的CEO韦恩·拉皮埃尔，

sentences.en: and also Chris Cox, who's their chief lobbyiSt.
sentences.zh: 还有他们的首席说客克里斯·科克斯。

sentences.en: And, you know, the but is.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这个“但是”是。

sentences.en: It's time.
sentences.zh: 是时候了。

sentences.en: We've got to stop this nonsense.
sentences.zh: 我们必须停止这种胡闹。

sentences.en: It's time.
sentences.zh: 是时候了。

sentences.en: And that's the hard turn that I think nobody in that room had expected.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个房间里没有人预料到的急转弯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's especially striking because historically the biggest fans of the Second Amendment do not say, I'm a big fan of the NRA, but.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这尤其令人震惊，因为从历史上看，宪法第二修正案的坚定支持者是不会说“我是NRA的超级粉丝，但是”这种话的。

sentences.en: There's no but.
sentences.zh: 没有什么“但是”。

sentences.en: There's no but.
sentences.zh: 没有什么“但是”。

sentences.en: If there's one characteristic for the NRA over the last, at least the last decade or two, it's been absolutism, right?
sentences.zh: 如果说NRA在过去，至少在过去一二十年里有一个特征的话，那就是绝对主义，对吧？

sentences.en: It's been this idea that you can't give an inch, because if you give an inch, they're coming for your guns, and government is going to take away your right to bear arMs.
sentences.zh: 这种观点认为你不能退让半步，因为如果你退让半步，他们就会冲着你的枪来，政府将剥夺你拥枪的权利。

sentences.en: And the idea that a Republican president of the United States says,
sentences.zh: 而美国的一位共和党总统却说：

sentences.en: I love the NRA, but, I mean, that's a pretty remarkable moment.
sentences.zh: 我热爱NRA，但是，我的意思是，这是一个相当了不起的时刻。

sentences.en: With that, I think I'd like to start.
sentences.zh: 借此机会，我想开始。

sentences.en: Maybe I'll ask John, you can start off, and then we'll go back and forth.
sentences.zh: 也许我请约翰你先开始，然后我们再来回讨论。

sentences.en: So talk me through what happens next.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲接下来发生了什么。

sentences.en: Well, next, Trump throws it to the room.
sentences.zh: 嗯，接下来，特朗普把问题抛给了在场的其他人。

sentences.en: He essentially invites the members of Congress that are sitting around him to give him their ideas.
sentences.zh: 他基本上邀请坐在他周围的国会议员向他提出他们的想法。

sentences.en: And they do.
sentences.zh: 他们也这样做了。

sentences.en: So Senator Murphy and I and 46 Senate colleagues on a bipartisan basis have what we think is a start.
sentences.zh: 所以默菲参议员和我以及另外46位跨党派的参议员有一个我们认为是个开端的方案。

sentences.en: You have Senator Cornyn talk about a bill that he has to help strengthen the data in the background check system.
sentences.zh: 科宁参议员谈到了他的一项旨在帮助加强背景调查系统数据的法案。

sentences.en: You have Senators Toomey and Manchin talking about their universal background check proposal that has been on the table for a long time.
sentences.zh: 图米参议员和曼钦参议员谈到了他们提出很久的普遍背景调查提案。

sentences.en: Diane, do you have something?
sentences.zh: 黛安，你有什么要说的吗？

sentences.en: Well, I do, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有的，总统先生。

sentences.en: You have Senator Feinstein talking about assault weapons.
sentences.zh: 范斯坦参议员谈到了攻击性武器。

sentences.en: I would be most honored if you would take a look at it.
sentences.zh: 如果您能看一看，我将感到十分荣幸。

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: And we will get it to you and let us know what you think of it.
sentences.zh: 我们会把它交给你，并让我们知道你对它的看法。

sentences.en: I will.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Essentially, the president's response to all of it, Democrat or Republican, it sort of seems not to matter.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，总统对所有这些的回应，无论是民主党人还是共和党人，似乎都无关紧要。

sentences.en: But his response to all of it is more.
sentences.zh: 但他对所有这些的回应都是：更多。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It would be so beautiful to have one bill that everybody could support as opposed to, you know, 15 bills.
sentences.zh: 能有一项所有人都能支持的法案，而不是像现在这样有15项法案，那该多美妙啊。

sentences.en: Everybody's got their own bill.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有自己的法案。

sentences.en: But if we could have one terrific bill that everybody started by the people around this table.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们能有一项由这桌人发起的、极棒的法案。

sentences.en: And how are lawmakers in the room reacting to the president kind of vacuuming all this up?
sentences.zh: 房间里的议员们对总统把这一切全盘吸收作何反应？

sentences.en: Well, it depends on which party they're in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这取决于他们属于哪个党派。

sentences.en: The Democrats, as it goes along and as they see the president not swatting down their ideas, they become energized.
sentences.zh: 随着会议的进行，民主党人看到总统没有拒绝他们的想法，他们变得兴奋起来。

sentences.en: You could just tell the energy in the room among the Democrats was palpable.
sentences.zh: 你可以清楚地感受到房间里民主党人之间的那种活力是显而易见的。

sentences.en: The Republicans, on the other hand, were stone-faced.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，共和党人则面无表情。

sentences.en: I mean, you could sort of see them trying to figure out what is happening here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你能看出他们试图弄清楚这里到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And Senator Cornyn was silent.
sentences.zh: 而科宁参议员则保持沉默。

sentences.en: You could just sort of see them not quite knowing how do you tell the president, no, Mr. President, you're wrong on this.
sentences.zh: 你能看出他们不太知道该怎么对总统说：“不，总统先生，你在这点上错了。”

sentences.en: Because the president didn't seem to be in that mode.
sentences.zh: 因为总统似乎并不处于那种状态。

sentences.en: The president seemed to be in the mode of, give me more.
sentences.zh: 总统似乎处于这种状态：给我更多。

sentences.en: I'll take all of this.
sentences.zh: 这一切我全盘接受。

sentences.en: And what about Senator Dianne Feinstein?
sentences.zh: 那么黛安·范斯坦参议员呢？

sentences.en: I think of her as this perpetually disappointed figure fighting for gun control for years when it's seemed basically impossible to have even the smallest effect.
sentences.zh: 我认为她是一个永远感到失望的人物，多年来一直在为枪支管控而战，而当时甚至连产生哪怕一点点影响似乎都基本不可能。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, so she has been literally one of the most impassioned voices, often to no end.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她可以说是最激昂的声音之一，但往往无果而终。

sentences.en: So, you know, I think initially when she mentioned the assault weapons ban early in the meeting when the president turned to her, I think she didn't expect much.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我想最初在会议早些时候，当总统转向她时，她提到攻击性武器禁令时并没有抱太大期望。

sentences.en: But you could see her whole mood kind of lightened.
sentences.zh: 但你能看到她的整个情绪缓和了下来。

sentences.en: She was smiling.
sentences.zh: 她在微笑。

sentences.en: She was grinning almoSt.
sentences.zh: 她几乎在咧嘴笑。

sentences.en: And at one point...
sentences.zh: 而且在某个时刻……

sentences.en: I put my case in writing, which I will give you, if I may, in letter form.
sentences.zh: 我把我的理由写成了文字，如果可以的话，我将以信件的形式交给你。

sentences.en: She had a piece of paper with some statistics on it that she wanted to show him.
sentences.zh: 她手里有一张写有一些统计数据的纸，想拿给他看。

sentences.en: And so she kind of leaned in her shoulder and President Trump leaned over.
sentences.zh: 于是她稍微探过身子，特朗普总统也俯身过来。

sentences.en: And the two of them were looking at this paper as she was sort of describing the sort of statistics that she wanted to show him.
sentences.zh: 当她描述她想向他展示的统计数据时，他们两个一起看着这张纸。

sentences.en: This is when the 10-year assault weapon ban was in.
sentences.zh: 这就是10年攻击性武器禁令实施的时候。

sentences.en: How incidents and deaths dropped.
sentences.zh: 事件和死亡人数是如何下降的。

sentences.en: When it ended, you see it going up.
sentences.zh: 当它结束时，你看到它在上升。

sentences.en: It was just one of these moments where, like, they looked like partners, almoSt.
sentences.zh: 这正是那种“看起来几乎像合作伙伴”的时刻。

sentences.en: If you didn't know any better, you could imagine a president and a senator who, you know, have long been friends.
sentences.zh: 如果你不太了解情况，你可能会以为这是一位总统和一位长期以来一直是朋友的参议员。

sentences.en: And, you know, because it sort of physically looked like that kind of dynamic.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，因为从外表上看确实是那种动态。

sentences.en: Joe and Pat, you're going to have to discuss that.
sentences.zh: 乔和帕特，你们得讨论一下这个。

sentences.en: You'll sit down with Diane and everybody else and you'll come up with something.
sentences.zh: 你们将和黛安以及其他人坐下来，想出一个方案。

sentences.en: And I think it, I really believe it has to be very strong.
sentences.zh: 我想，我真的相信它必须非常强有力。

sentences.en: So, I think the next interesting moment came on the issue of whether or not the minimum age for buying a semi-automatic weapon like the one used in the Florida shootings,
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为下一个有趣的时刻出现在关于购买半自动武器（比如佛罗里达州枪击案中使用的那种武器）的最低年龄问题上，

sentences.en: whether the minimum age should be raised from 18 to 21.
sentences.zh: 最低年龄是否应该从18岁提高到21岁。

sentences.en: The president has, in the past, kind of embraced the idea.
sentences.zh: 总统过去曾支持过这个想法。

sentences.en: And in this meeting, he brings it up.
sentences.zh: 而在这次会议上，他把它提了出来。

sentences.en: I'll tell you what, I'm going to give it a lot of consideration.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你们吧，我会对此进行大量考虑。

sentences.en: And I'm the one bringing it up.
sentences.zh: 而且是我把它提出来的。

sentences.en: And a lot of people don't even want to bring it up because they're afraid to bring it up.
sentences.zh: 很多人甚至不愿意提它，因为他们害怕提起。

sentences.en: But you can't buy a handgun at 18, 19, or 20.
sentences.zh: 但在18岁、19岁或20岁时，你不能买手枪。

sentences.en: You have to wait till you're 21.
sentences.zh: 你必须等到21岁。

sentences.en: But you can buy the gun, the weapon used in this horrible shooting at 18.
sentences.zh: 但你可以在18岁时买到枪，也就是这起可怕枪击案中使用的武器。

sentences.en: And he's just incredulous.
sentences.zh: 他简直感到难以置信。

sentences.en: He's sort of looking at this logic.
sentences.zh: 他在审视这种逻辑。

sentences.en: He said, this just doesn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 他说，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: It doesn't make sense that I have to wait till I'm 21 to get a handgun, but I can get this weapon at 18.
sentences.zh: 我必须等到21岁才能买手枪，却能在18岁时买到这种武器，这说不通。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: And he launches into a kind of political analysis of that piece of legislation, which the NRA fiercely opposes.
sentences.zh: 接着他开始对该项立法进行某种政治分析，而NRA对此坚决反对。

sentences.en: And he sort of acknowledges that.
sentences.zh: 他也意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: I can say that the NRA is opposed to it.
sentences.zh: 我可以这么说，NRA是反对它的。

sentences.en: And I'm a fan of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 而我是NRA的粉丝。

sentences.en: I mean, there's no bigger fan.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，没有比这更大的粉丝了。

sentences.en: I'm a big fan of the NRA.
sentences.zh: 我是NRA的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: They want to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们想做好事。

sentences.en: These are great people.
sentences.zh: 这些都是伟大的人。

sentences.en: These are great patriots.
sentences.zh: 这些都是伟大的爱国者。

sentences.en: They love our country.
sentences.zh: 他们热爱我们的国家。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean we have to agree on everything.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着我们必须在所有事情上都意见一致。

sentences.en: Mike, given the extent to which the president is breaking from party orthodoxy here on guns,
sentences.zh: 迈克，鉴于总统在枪支问题上偏离党派正统观念的程度，

sentences.en: what's going on with his vice president, Mike Pence, who's sitting right across from him in this room and has historically been very loyal to the NRA?
sentences.zh: 他的副总统迈克·彭斯在这间屋子里就坐在他正对面，历来对美国全国步枪协会（NRA）非常忠诚，他现在情况如何？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this actually may have been my favorite moment in the whole hour just because it was so strikingly different from what you would ever hear from a Republican.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这实际上可能是整整一小时里我最喜欢的一个时刻，因为这与你从任何共和党人那里听到的内容都有着惊人的不同。

sentences.en: It went viral.
sentences.zh: 这在网上疯传。

sentences.en: Yes, go ahead, Mike.
sentences.zh: 好的，请说，迈克。

sentences.en: Well, in the category, you've spoken about, Mr. President, gun violence restraining orders.
sentences.zh: 好的，总统先生，在您刚才谈到的那个类别中，枪支暴力限制令。

sentences.en: The president recognizes his vice president, Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 总统注意到了他的副总统迈克·彭斯。

sentences.en: The vice president begins talking about, are there ways that we can identify people who are a danger to themselves or a danger to others?
sentences.zh: 副总统开始谈论，我们是否有办法识别出对自身或他人构成危险的人？

sentences.en: To literally give families and give local law enforcement additional tools if an individual is reported to be a potential danger to themselves.
sentences.zh: 如果有人被举报可能对自身构成潜在危险，就切实赋予家属和地方执法部门额外的工具。

sentences.en: So he's very careful, as all Republicans are, to say, but of course, we would only do that with the appropriate due process.
sentences.zh: 因此，和所有共和党人一样，他非常谨慎地说，但当然，我们只会通过适当的正当程序来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Allow due process so that no one's rights are trampled, but the ability to go to court, obtain an order, and then collect not only the firearms, but any weapons.
sentences.zh: 允许正当程序，以便没有人的权利受到践踏，但有能力向法院提起诉讼、获得命令，然后不仅没收枪支，还没收任何武器。

sentences.en: And the president interrupts him.
sentences.zh: 总统打断了他。

sentences.en: Or Mike, take the firearms first and then go to court, because that's another system.
sentences.zh: 或者迈克，先没收枪支，然后再去法院，因为那是另一套系统。

sentences.en: Because a lot of times, by the time you go to court, it takes so long to go to court to get the due process procedures.
sentences.zh: 因为很多时候，等你走到法院那一步时，通过正当程序走完法律程序需要很长时间。

sentences.en: I like taking the guns early, like in this crazy man's case that just took place in Florida.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尽早收缴枪支，就像刚刚在佛罗里达州发生的这个疯子的案子一样。

sentences.en: He had a lot of firearMs.
sentences.zh: 他有很多枪支。

sentences.en: They saw everything.
sentences.zh: 他们把一切都看在眼里。

sentences.en: To go to court would have taken a long time.
sentences.zh: 去法院会花很长时间。

sentences.en: So you could do exactly what you're saying, but take the guns first, go through due process.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以完全照你说的做，但先收缴枪支，然后再经历正当程序。

sentences.en: The whole idea of due process is that you go through the due process before the thing happens.
sentences.zh: 正当程序的整个理念是，你在事情发生之前经历正当程序。

sentences.en: So you can't have the thing happening and then go through due process.
sentences.zh: 所以你不能让事情发生了再去经历正当程序。

sentences.en: It just doesn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: But the head's exploding in conservative world on the idea that an American president would openly talk about just, like,
sentences.zh: 但是一想到美国总统会公开谈论这种事情，保守派世界里的人都快气炸了，比如

sentences.en: identifying people who they don't think should have guns and taking them.
sentences.zh: 识别出那些他们认为不该拥有枪支的人并将其收缴。

sentences.en: And then, like, at some point in the future, we'll go through some sort of due process to make sure that that was okay.
sentences.zh: 然后，比如在未来的某个时刻，我们会经历某种正当程序，以确保这样做是没有问题的。

sentences.en: I mean, the reaction to that was reflected most kind of dramatically on the Breitbart website, which very quickly put up a headline in bright red, all caps, Trump the gun grabber.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对此的反应在布赖特巴特网站上得到了最戏剧性的反映，该网站非常快地用鲜红色的全大写字母打出了一个大标题：“枪支收缴者特朗普”。

sentences.en: As if it's some kind of Second Amendment nightmare.
sentences.zh: 就好像这是某种宪法第二修正案的噩梦一样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And from the standpoint of somebody who has long been a, you know, Second Amendment supporter, right, if you're one of those folks, that just sends a chill down your back.
sentences.zh: 而从一个长期以来一直是，你知道的，第二修正案支持者的角度来看，如果你是其中一员，这简直会让你不寒而栗。

sentences.en: Mike, what we saw in this room on Wednesday with this guns meeting reminds me of a listening session that the president held with lawmakers last month about DACA and immigration.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我们周三在这间屋子里看到的这场关于枪支的会议，让我想起了总统上个月与国会议员就“追梦人计划”（DACA）和移民问题举行的一场听证会。

sentences.en: It feels quite similar.
sentences.zh: 感觉相当相似。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much, everyone, for being here.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢大家的光临。

sentences.en: I'm thrilled to be with a distinguished group of Republican and Democratic lawmakers from both the House and the Senate.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能与来自众议院和参议院的一群杰出的共和党和民主党国会议员在一起。

sentences.en: He calls together all the key players into the White House.
sentences.zh: 他把所有关键人物召集到白宫。

sentences.en: We're here today to advance bipartisan immigration reform that serves the needs of the American families, workers, and taxpayers.
sentences.zh: 我们今天在这里是为了推进两党移民改革，以满足美国家庭、工人和纳税人的需求。

sentences.en: Promises bipartisan legislation.
sentences.zh: 承诺进行两党立法。

sentences.en: Says he wants to make a deal across the aisle, get something done.
sentences.zh: 表示他希望跨越党派达成交易，办成一些事情。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 并且……

sentences.en: I'd like to ask the question, what about a clean DACA bill now?
sentences.zh: 我想问一个问题，现在通过一项单纯的DACA法案怎么样？

sentences.en: He shocks the Democrats in the room with what he indicates he's open to.
sentences.zh: 他用自己表现出的开放态度震惊了屋子里的民主党人。

sentences.en: I have no problem.
sentences.zh: 我没有问题。

sentences.en: I think that's basically what Dick is saying.
sentences.zh: 我认为这基本上就是迪克所说的。

sentences.en: We're going to come out with DACA.
sentences.zh: 我们将推出DACA。

sentences.en: But, of course, days after that DACA meeting, things changed.
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，在那次DACA会议几天后，事情发生了变化。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: At a news conference, the president took another whack at clarifying his position on immigration,
sentences.zh: 在一次新闻发布会上，总统再次试图澄清他在移民问题上的立场，

sentences.en: insisting that a wall on the border with Mexico be a part of any deal to protect the roughly 800,000 undocumented dreamers from deportation.
sentences.zh: 坚决要求在与墨西哥的边境上修建一堵墙，作为保护大约80万无证追梦人免遭驱逐出境的任何协议的一部分。

sentences.en: And it didn't just change.
sentences.zh: 而且事情不仅仅是改变了。

sentences.en: Trump completely did a 180 over the course of the next several weeks.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，特朗普彻底来了个180度大转弯。

sentences.en: Reports say the headline-making remarks happened during a meeting on immigration in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 据报道，这些引发头条新闻的言论发生在椭圆形办公室的一次移民会议期间。

sentences.en: When talk turned to Haiti and countries in Africa at that meeting, he apparently said, this is a quote, why are we having all these people from shithole countries come here?
sentences.zh: 当会议上的谈话转向海地和非洲国家时，他显然说了一句原话：“我们为什么让所有这些来自粪坑国家的人来到这里？”

sentences.en: He then suggested that the United States should instead bring more people from countries like Norway.
sentences.zh: 接着他建议，美国应该转而从挪威这样的国家引进更多的人。

sentences.en: He went from being open to all of these ideas on immigration in that meeting to becoming one of the most hardline voices that killed the sort of bipartisan immigration consensus that was forming,
sentences.zh: 在那次会议上，他对移民问题上的所有这些想法持开放态度，结果却变成了最强硬的声音之一，扼杀了正在形成的两党移民共识，

sentences.en: at least in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 至少在参议院是这样。

sentences.en: There had been this sort of bipartisan effort that has burned into the minds of Democrats who have been pushing for gun control.
sentences.zh: 一直存在这种两党共同努力的迹象，这已经深深烙印在一直推动枪支控制的民主党人的脑海中。

sentences.en: And I think, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，

sentences.en: you definitely send some skepticism after the meeting that when push comes to shove and legislation is actually proposed and the president starts tweeting again in the mornings
sentences.zh: 会议结束后你绝对会产生一些怀疑：当真的到了关键时刻、提出实际立法、并且总统开始在清晨再次发推特时，

sentences.en: and his hardline advisors start whispering in his ear and the Republican allies start calling him, you know,
sentences.zh: 当他强硬的顾问开始在他耳边低声细语、他的共和党盟友开始打电话给他时，你知道的，

sentences.en: I think there's a fair bit of doubt that he'll actually stay the course and that this will, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为有相当多的怀疑态度，怀疑他是否会真正坚持到底，这会被，你知道的，

sentences.en: be remembered as another one of those moments where he kind of freelanced before being kind of drawn back into the Republican fold in the end.
sentences.zh: 被人们记住是又一个这样的时刻：他在最后被拉回共和党阵营之前，曾一度表现得像个自由职业者一样随性而为。

sentences.en: Is there any reason to believe this will turn out any differently than that meeting on immigration?
sentences.zh: 有什么理由相信这次的结果会和那次移民会议有任何不同吗？

sentences.en: Because we're a week from the deadline for the Dreamers and we seem further than ever from an immigration deal.
sentences.zh: 因为距离追梦人的截止日期只有一周了，而且我们似乎比以往任何时候都更难达成移民协议。

sentences.en: So why would this gun discussion be different?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么这次的枪支讨论会有所不同呢？

sentences.en: As a skeptical journalist, I think it probably won't be.
sentences.zh: 作为一个持怀疑态度的记者，我认为可能不会不同。

sentences.en: I mean, I think if there's two things that I could identify that make it possible for something different to happen,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为如果能找出两点让事情有可能出现不同，

sentences.en: it would be the fact that the president is something of an X factor, that he's less able to be pigeonholed because he's just been less a part of this culture.
sentences.zh: 那将是以下事实：总统有点像个变数，他更不容易被归类，因为他较少参与这种文化。

sentences.en: And I think the kids of Stoneman Douglas who have injected a slightly different dynamic in their sort of political activism.
sentences.zh: 以及我认为道格拉斯高中（Stoneman Douglas）的孩子们以其特有的政治行动主义注入了一种略有不同的活力。

sentences.en: And, you know, we expect them to sort of keep that up over the next several weeks.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们预计他们在接下来的几周里会继续保持这种状态。

sentences.en: And if they do, and if that contributes to a kind of a different atmosphere than we've seen in the past,
sentences.zh: 如果他们做到了，并且这有助于营造一种不同于以往的氛围，

sentences.en: I suppose those are the two things that I would suggest you could sort of see that might make this different.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我会指出的两点，你或许能从中看到可能让这次情况变得不同的因素。

sentences.en: Though, you know, if I was a betting man, I'd say probably not.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道的，如果我是个好赌的人，我会说可能不会。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mike.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Happy to do it.
sentences.zh: 乐意效劳。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, two of the nation's leading gun sellers announced plans to restrict the sale of firearMs.
sentences.zh: 周三，全美两家领先的枪支零售商宣布了限制枪支销售的计划。

sentences.en: Walmart said it would stop selling guns to anyone under the age of 21.
sentences.zh: 沃尔玛表示将停止向21岁以下的人出售枪支。

sentences.en: And Dick's Sporting Goods said it would stop selling assault-style weapons altogether and would no longer sell high-capacity magazines to anyone under 21.
sentences.zh: 迪克体育用品公司（Dick's Sporting Goods）表示将完全停止销售突击步枪，并不再向21岁以下的人出售大容量弹匣。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金（Andrew Ross Sorkin）。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯DealBook的商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场舞台上采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括J·D·

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼（Zylran Mondani）以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于NYTimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: She has been at Donald Trump's side going back to the beginning of the campaign.
sentences.zh: 从竞选一开始，她就一直陪伴在唐纳德·特朗普身边。

sentences.en: Came from the Trump Organization, a loyal spokeswoman for the president.
sentences.zh: 她出身于特朗普集团，是总统忠实的发言人。

sentences.en: In the White House, her job has really kind of been the Trump whisperer.
sentences.zh: 在白宫，她的工作实际上有点像是“特朗普传声筒”（Trump whisperer）。

sentences.en: She views her job to defend the Trump brand.
sentences.zh: 她将自己的工作视为捍卫特朗普品牌。

sentences.en: There have been tons of firings, hirings, people resigning from Donald Trump's orbit, and she has endured.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的身边有无数人被解雇、被雇用、辞职，而她坚持了下来。

sentences.en: Maggie, where did Hope Hicks come from?
sentences.zh: 麦琪，霍普·希克斯（Hope Hicks）是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: So Hope Hicks has been working for the Trump family for about six years.
sentences.zh: 所以霍普·希克斯为特朗普家族工作了大约六年。

sentences.en: She began working for Ivanka Trump.
sentences.zh: 她开始时是为伊万卡·特朗普工作。

sentences.en: Maggie Haberman covers the White House for the Times.
sentences.zh: 麦琪·哈伯曼（Maggie Haberman）为《时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: You know, the president knew who she was, liked her, poached her for his campaign team
sentences.zh: 你知道的，总统知道她是谁，喜欢她，把她挖到了他的竞选团队中，

sentences.en: when he was not really attracting a lot of people who were familiar with politics who wanted to work for him.
sentences.zh: 当时他并没有吸引到太多熟悉政治、想要为他工作的人。

sentences.en: Hope Hicks was not familiar with politics.
sentences.zh: 霍普·希克斯对政治并不熟悉。

sentences.en: She signed up.
sentences.zh: 她加入了。

sentences.en: She was part of this core group of a handful of original aides, and she is one of the ones who has lasted the longest by his side.
sentences.zh: 她是最初这少数几个核心幕僚之一，也是陪伴在他身边最久的人之一。

sentences.en: She had one of the least visible profiles of any White House communications director I can even think of.
sentences.zh: 在我能想到的所有白宫通讯联络主任中，她的曝光率可以说是最低的之一。

sentences.en: I think you couldn't find a television interview that she has ever given.
sentences.zh: 我想你找不到她曾经接受过的任何电视采访。

sentences.en: She's been on stage, I think, maybe two or three times with the president.
sentences.zh: 我想她和总统同台过大概两到三次。

sentences.en: She's quoted in stories, but that's really it.
sentences.zh: 她在报道中被引述，但真的仅此而已。

sentences.en: So what is it that has made her so powerful exactly?
sentences.zh: 那么，究竟是什么让她如此强大呢？

sentences.en: What is it about her?
sentences.zh: 她到底有什么特别之处？

sentences.en: Because she understands the president better than anybody.
sentences.zh: 因为她比任何人都更了解总统。

sentences.en: I mean, look, she would constantly do battle with him.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听着，她会不断与他争辩。

sentences.en: She would call control rooms arguing on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 她会打电话给控制室为他辩护。

sentences.en: She would call reporters.
sentences.zh: 她会打电话给记者。

sentences.en: I have had more than my share of fights with her.
sentences.zh: 我和她吵架的次数绝对不在少数。

sentences.en: She also would sort of, as much as she filtered to people, there was a lot that she did not end up relaying.
sentences.zh: 她也总是这样，尽管她为人们过滤了很多信息，但也有很多事情她最终并没有转达。

sentences.en: I mean, just as an example, without betraying details of things that were off the record, but on a story that I had a huge fight with the White House about last year,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，仅举个例子，在不透露非公开细节的前提下，但就我去年与白宫发生过巨大争执的一篇报道而言，

sentences.en: she and I had an argument about it, and she relayed the president's displeasure, which I considered unreasonable, his reaction, and narrowly focused.
sentences.zh: 她和我为此争论过，她转达了总统的不满——我认为这是不合理的——他的反应，以及狭隘的焦点。

sentences.en: And it didn't impact our reporting.
sentences.zh: 这并没有影响我们的报道。

sentences.en: But I found out from somebody else later the full extent of what the president had said and how much had not been relayed.
sentences.zh: 但我后来从别人那里得知了总统所说的话的全部内容，以及有多少内容没有被转达。

sentences.en: She spent a lot of time navigating both sides of that.
sentences.zh: 她花了很多时间在双方之间进行周旋。

sentences.en: So what happened on Wednesday?
sentences.zh: 那么周三发生了什么？

sentences.en: What happened on Wednesday was that Hope Hicks told the president she was leaving, and she told her colleagues, and we learned about it and reported it.
sentences.zh: 周三发生的事情是，霍普·希克斯告诉总统她要离职了，她也告诉了她的同事，我们得知了此事并进行了报道。

sentences.en: The internet sort of immediately exploded when you broke this news, Maggie, because after three years of managing to keep herself out of the story,
sentences.zh: 麦琪，当你打破这个新闻时，互联网立刻就炸了锅，因为在三年的时间里，希克斯一直设法让自己置身于新闻事件之外，

sentences.en: Hicks has been in the headlines in a major way these past few weeks.
sentences.zh: 而在过去的几周里，希克斯却一直在各大头条中占据重要版面。

sentences.en: First, when President Trump's staff secretary, Rob Porter, resigned after two ex-wives accused him of domestic abuse, it was reported that Hicks had been dating Porter.
sentences.zh: 首先是当特朗普总统的工作秘书罗布·波特（Rob Porter）在两任前妻指控他家庭暴力后辞职时，据报道希克斯一直在与波特约会。

sentences.en: And then, just on Tuesday, the day before she says she's resigning, it's reported that in closed-door testimony in front of the House Intelligence Committee,
sentences.zh: 然后就在周二，也就是她宣布辞职的前一天，据报道，在众议院情报委员会的闭门听证会上，

sentences.en: Hicks said that she tells white lies on behalf of the president.
sentences.zh: 希克斯表示，她曾代表总统说善意的谎言。

sentences.en: So, settle it for us.
sentences.zh: 所以，给我们做个了断吧。

sentences.en: Are either or both of these stories connected to her resignation?
sentences.zh: 这两条新闻中有一条还是两条都与她的辞职有关？

sentences.en: The story about what she said to the committee had nothing to do with this.
sentences.zh: 关于她对委员会说的话的那篇报道与此毫无关系。

sentences.en: I understand that it is frustrating to people to not understand why I know that, but I do know that.
sentences.zh: 我明白大家不理解我为什么知道这一点会感到沮丧，但我确实知道。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And I know it definitively.
sentences.zh: 而且我对此非常确定。

sentences.en: In terms of the Rob Porter issue, I don't think that was a fun period for her.
sentences.zh: 就罗布·波特的问题而言，我认为对她来说那不是一段愉快的时期。

sentences.en: She has had to contend with being both the person trying to manage the news and being the news herself.
sentences.zh: 她不得不一边努力掌控新闻，一边自己却成了新闻人物。

sentences.en: So, the Porter incident might have contributed to her decision, not because anyone wanted her out.
sentences.zh: 因此，波特事件可能促成了她的决定，并不是因为任何人想逼她走。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: But because suddenly there was an attention that, as you've said, she so assiduously tries to avoid.
sentences.zh: 而是因为突然之间有了正如你所说的那种她一直刻意极力避免的关注。

sentences.en: I think if you think about the list of things that we have just talked about that her job has entailed, who would want that job?
sentences.zh: 我想如果你想想我们刚刚谈到的、她的工作所涉及的那些事情，谁会想要那份工作？

sentences.en: And frankly, look, I mean, there's another reason which we haven't discussed, which is her Tuesday appearance on the Hill did not relate to this.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，听着，还有另一个我们没有讨论的原因，那就是她周二在国会山的出面与此无关。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that the Russia issue doesn't relate to, you know, her thinking.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着“通俄门”问题与她的想法无关。

sentences.en: Meaning the investigation is weighing on her.
sentences.zh: 意思是这项调查正在给她带来沉重的压力。

sentences.en: She has been a focus of the Russia investigations in terms of what she knew about meetings that
sentences.zh: 她一直是“通俄门”调查的焦点，关于她所了解到的会议情况，

sentences.en: were held or the firing of James Comey and what took place before that, or the drafting
sentences.zh: 即举行的会议、詹姆士·科米（James Comey）被解职及之前发生的事情，或者起草

sentences.en: of a statement aboard Air Force One in response to a story that we were doing about a meeting that Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 在空军一号上的一份声明，以回应我们正在做的一篇关于唐纳德·特朗普 Jr.（Donald Trump Jr.）

sentences.en: took with a Russian lawyer who had claimed to have, quote unquote, dirt about Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 与一位声称拥有关于希拉里·克林顿的所谓“黑料”的俄罗斯女律师会面的报道。

sentences.en: Because of her proximity to the president, she was present for a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 由于她与总统关系密切，她出席了许多事情。

sentences.en: And so that has made her, you know, sort of a vulnerable target.
sentences.zh: 因此，这使她成为了你知道的某种脆弱的目标。

sentences.en: And I think that every day that she's at the White House is a day where she's got more legal exposure.
sentences.zh: 我认为她在白宫的每一天，都是她面临更多法律风险的一天。

sentences.en: So at a certain point, why would you do that to yourself?
sentences.zh: 所以在某个时刻，你为什么要对自己做这种事？

sentences.en: Why would she be more legally exposed inside the White House than outside the White House?
sentences.zh: 为什么她在白宫内部会比在白宫外部面临更多的法律风险？

sentences.en: I know neither of us are lawyers, but...
sentences.zh: 我知道我们两个都不是律师，但是……

sentences.en: Well, because she's going to, in theory, she could end up hearing more things the president might want
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为从理论上讲，她最终可能会听到更多总统可能想要做的事，

sentences.en: to do about, you know, possibly, say, getting rid of Bob Mueller, the special counsel, or wanting to get rid of Rod Rosenstein, the deputy attorney general, or wanting to scream
sentences.zh: 比方说，可能关于解雇特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒，或者想要解雇副司法部长罗德·罗森斯坦，或者想要大发雷霆

sentences.en: about Jeff Sessions, not protecting him on Russia, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 抱怨杰夫·塞申斯在俄罗斯问题上没有保护他，诸如此类。

sentences.en: So in that case, proximity to the president could become a legal liability.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种情况下，接近总统可能会变成一种法律上的负累。

sentences.en: Proximity could become a liability, correct.
sentences.zh: 接近总统可能会成为一种负累，没错。

sentences.en: Don't we expect that Robert Mueller could be coming after Hope Hicks now that she's leaving with the idea that she's out of the White House, and thus sort of a freer figure when
sentences.zh: 我们难道不预料罗伯特·穆勒现在会冲着霍普·希克斯来吗？因为她就要离职了，这意味着她将离开白宫，

sentences.en: it comes to talking about what she saw, and with fewer legal protections that you might have when you're in the West Wing?
sentences.zh: 因此在谈论她所见所闻时，她某种程度上会成为一个更自由的人物，并且不像在西翼时那样享有那么多法律保护？

sentences.en: It certainly could be.
sentences.zh: 完全有这种可能。

sentences.en: And look, I mean, the risk when you leave is that the proximity buys a little bit of protection, right?
sentences.zh: 而且听着，我的意思是，离职时的风险在于，这种距离感带来了一点保护，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know that it leaves her more exposed.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这会不会让她面临更大的风险。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, a lot of this is theoretical because we don't know what her conversations are with Mueller.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道的，这其中很大一部分都是理论上的，因为我们不知道她和穆勒之间谈了些什么。

sentences.en: If I'm not wrong, Maggie, Hope Hicks is the fifth or sixth person to have served in this communications role.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，如果我没记错的话，霍普·希克斯是第五个还是第六个担任这个传讯职务的人。

sentences.en: And while you say that the white lie comment had nothing to do with her leaving, it does seem to speak to how hard it must be to be the mouthpiece for this White House and this
sentences.zh: 虽然你说那个善意的谎言的评论和她的离职毫无关系，但它确实说明了要成为这个白宫和这位

sentences.en: president, because she's essentially acknowledged that she had to tell—she calls them white lies—but lies to do her job.
sentences.zh: 总统的喉舌有多么困难，因为她基本上承认了她不得不说谎——她称之为善意的谎言——但为了工作她不得不说谎。

sentences.en: So is that just an impossible role, being communications director or being strategic communications director for this White House?
sentences.zh: 那么，担任这个白宫的传讯总监或战略传讯总监，是不是一个根本无法完成的角色？

sentences.en: There's no question.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: I mean, working for him just grinds you down.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为他工作简直会把你折磨得精疲力竭。

sentences.en: That becomes impossible after a while.
sentences.zh: 过一段时间后，这就会变得不可能坚持。

sentences.en: You start to—I mean, the number of people in the White House who have said to me they feel like they're losing their minds and how free they have all felt when they left is huge.
sentences.zh: 你开始——我的意思是，白宫里有相当多的人对我说过，他们觉得自己快要疯了，而且他们离开时感觉是多么地自由，这个数字非常庞大。

sentences.en: And I suspect she will end up as one of them.
sentences.zh: 我猜她最后也会成为他们中的一员。

sentences.en: So would you say that ultimately she left because this is an impossible job?
sentences.zh: 那么你会说她最终离职是因为这是一份无法胜任的工作吗？

sentences.en: I think she left for a lot of reasons, but I certainly think that is one of them.
sentences.zh: 我认为她离职有很多原因，但我当然认为这是其中之一。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Maggie.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，玛吉。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the long-simmering tension between President Trump and Attorney General Jeff
sentences.zh: 周三，长期酝酿的特朗普总统与司法部长杰夫·

sentences.en: Sessions came to a head in a public face-off between the two men.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯之间的紧张关系在两人公开的正面冲突中达到了白热化。

sentences.en: It began with a tweet from President Trump calling Sessions disgraceful for suggesting that
sentences.zh: 这一切始于特朗普总统的一条推文，他在推文中称塞申斯可耻，因为塞申斯建议

sentences.en: the Justice Department's independent inspector general look into the handling of the Russia investigation in its early months, rather than ordering the Justice Department itself
sentences.zh: 司法部独立的督察长去调查俄罗斯调查早期的处理情况，而不是下令司法部自己

sentences.en: to do so.
sentences.zh: 去这样做。

sentences.en: Sessions, who has absorbed the president's previous criticisms in silence, responded with a rare statement defending himself.
sentences.zh: 此前一直默默承受总统批评的塞申斯发表了一份罕见的声明为自己辩护。

sentences.en: As long as I am the attorney general, I will continue to discharge my duties with integrity and honor, he said.
sentences.zh: 只要我还是司法部长，我就会继续以廉正和荣誉履行我的职责，他说。

sentences.en: And this department will continue to do its work in a fair and impartial manner, according to the law and constitution.
sentences.zh: 并且本部门将继续根据法律和宪法，以公平公正的方式开展工作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbara.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴拉。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在纽约时报应用程序或您喜欢收听的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
